as_of: Early-Asia preview Tue Sep 8 — US cash still on Labor Day holiday, oil races toward $100, Dow futures ~-300, yen tops 154, Asia chips firm

dow_jones.note: US CASH CLOSED (Labor Day). Dow futures ~-300 pts (pre-market) into the shortened Tue Sep 8 re-open, dragged by surging crude near $100. Fri close 53,414.25.

sp500.note: Reference Fri close ~7,718.60. Futures-led tone pointing modestly lower pre-open as energy-led inflation risk + hawkish Fed repricing dominate. Cash re-opens Tue.

nasdaq.note: Reference Fri close 26,506.99. Tech/AI steadied Friday; into Tuesday's open the AI complex watches 'model fatigue' reports and oil-driven macro for direction.

us_markets.note: US cash markets closed Mon Sep 7 for Labor Day; first full week trade is the shortened Tue Sep 8 session. Pre-market Dow futures down ~300 as Brent nears $100 and a deepening US-Iran/Hormuz supply crunch rattles the inflation outlook.

hang_seng.note: Prior close: HSI 25,413.12, -0.93%. Overnight Asia tone sees oil-led risk-off vs firmer regional chips; watch Tue Asia session follow-through.

hscei.note: Hang Seng China Enterprises 8,429.73, -1.47%. Mainland/H-share names underperformed Monday; oil and hawkish-Fed pressure are the key swing factors into Tue Asia.

hstech.note: Hang Seng TECH 4,527.71. Regional chip/tech tone is firming (Tokyo +2% on AI/chips; Samsung buyback) — a potential tailwind for HK tech, offset by oil/macro drag.

hong_kong.note: HK closed lower Monday. Heading into Tue Asia: regional semis bid on AI optimism, but crude near $100, yen strength and hawkish-Fed pricing are the overriding risk overlay for HK/H-share stocks.

btc.note: BTC ~$79,314 (-0.79% 24h) per CoinGecko. Drifted back below $79.5-80k; tracking oil-driven risk-off and firmer yen/dollar, with thin US-holiday liquidity.

eth.note: ETH ~$2,495.82 (-0.43% 24h). Slightly firmer than BTC on relative basis; direction tied to tech/AI sentiment versus the energy/macro headwind.

crypto.note: Crypto edging lower overnight as crude's surge to ~$100 sours risk appetite; volumes thin with US cash desks on holiday and Asia the marginal driver.

macro.oil_100_renewed_supply_crunch: CRITICAL: Brent racing toward $100 on a renewed supply crunch — US and Iran traded blows on each other's ships over the weekend and Saudi Aramco facilities were reportedly struck again. FT: 'Oil prices near $100.' Energy-led inflation is the dominant macro driver forcing hawkish-Fed repricing.
macro.iran_oman_deal_watch: Oil pulled back slightly on a Reuters/Bloomberg report that Iran says a deal with Oman is close — a potential de-escalation valve for the Hormuz premium. Watch for confirmation; any easing would relieve crude and yields simultaneously.
macro.us_futures_dow_300: Dow futures fell ~300 pts into the shortened week as oil climbed — markets set for a risk-off re-open Tuesday unless Iran-Oman progress cools crude.
macro.yen_154_intervention: Yen surged PAST 154 to a fresh 6-month / cycle high with traders on alert for BOJ intervention; Bloomberg notes the currency's 2026 high is in reach. Sharp FX stress is a global-liquidity watch item.
macro.asia_chips_rebound: Regional semis are the bright spot: Tokyo stocks rose over 2% Monday on AI/chip growth hopes and Samsung's buyback flagging Korea's preferred-share discount — early signs the post-DeepSeek AI rout is stabilizing in Asia even as 'model fatigue' worries circulate.
macro.canada_trump_tariffs: Canada set to hit back at Trump tariffs, risking a wider trade war — a fresh cross-border friction that adds to uncertainty alongside the oil shock.
macro.us_labor_day: US equity and bond markets CLOSED Monday Sep 7 for Labor Day. CME/global futures & crypto trade. US cash re-opens Tuesday Sep 8 in a shortened week.
macro.august_jobs: Nonfarm payrolls surged +162,000 in August (well above ~110k consensus). Blowout print keeps the 'will the Fed hike again?' debate alive, reinforcing hawkish pricing into the oil shock.
macro.september_watch: Focus: oil at ~$100 and whether the US-Iran/Oman situation eases Hormuz risk; yen intervention; US cash re-open Tuesday after Dow futures -300; Canada-US tariff retaliation; and whether Asia's chip rebound holds.

headlines.title: Oil prices near $100 as renewed supply crunch looms
headlines.impact: Brent ~$100; energy-inflation pressures the hawkish-Fed trade and pressures equity multiples. Top macro risk of the session.

headlines.title: Oil extends gain, Iran says deal with Oman is close
headlines.impact: Possible near-term cap on the Hormuz premium — key swing that would ease both crude and bond pressure.

headlines.title: Tokyo stocks rise over 2% on AI and chip growth hopes as yen gains
headlines.impact: Regional semis stabilize after the DeepSeek rout; a firmer yen trims export upside but signals FX stress.
